query: 2026 gubernatorial debates scheduled summer 2026 Pennsylvania Shapiro Garrity, Oregon Kotek Drazan, Arizona Hobbs, Wisconsin - any debate before September 2026
answer:
## Summary

**Direct answer: No general-election gubernatorial debate is scheduled before September 2026 in any of the four races.** However, two states have **primary** debates before September because of their late-summer primaries.

| State | Debate before Sept 2026? | Details |
|-------|--------------------------|---------|
| **Wisconsin** | ✅ Yes (primary) | WISN 12 Democratic **primary** debate **July 28, 2026**, 7 Dems. General-election debates set for **Oct. 8 & 9**. Open seat (Evers not running). |
| **Arizona** | ✅ Yes (primary) | Clean Elections GOP **primary** debate **June 17, 2026** (Biggs, Schweikert, +2). Primary July 21; no Hobbs general debate before Sept. |
| **Oregon** | ❌ No | Kotek proposed 3 debates "**starting in September**"; she **declined** a summer newspaper-group debate (June 18). |
| **Pennsylvania** | ❌ No | Shapiro & Garrity both *willing* but **nothing scheduled** — no date/host/moderator. Garrity wants 7. |

**Key nuance:** If the underlying forecasting question is about the *general-election matchups* (Shapiro–Garrity, Kotek–Drazan, Hobbs–GOP nominee) meeting before September, the answer is clearly **none** — those are all targeted for September/October or remain unscheduled. The only pre-September debates are **primary** debates in WI (July 28) and AZ (June 17). Full structured findings with sources and dated data points have been recorded.

key_facts: Wisconsin holds a confirmed Democratic gubernatorial PRIMARY debate on WISN 12 on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, 7–8 p.m. (before September) featuring seven Democrats.
Wisconsin's gubernatorial primary is Aug. 11, 2026; it is an open seat (Gov. Evers not seeking re-election).
Wisconsin GENERAL-election gubernatorial debates are scheduled for October: TMJ4/ICC/UW-Milwaukee town hall Oct. 8, 2026 and WBA Foundation/Milwaukee PBS debate Oct. 9, 2026.

Arizona held a GOP primary gubernatorial debate on June 17, 2026 (Citizens Clean Elections Commission) with Biggs, Schweikert, Neely, and Miceli — a primary debate, not a Hobbs general-election debate.
Arizona's gubernatorial primary is July 21, 2026; the GOP general-election opponent for Gov. Katie Hobbs is not determined until after that date.
Oregon Gov. Tina Kotek challenged Christine Drazan (June 11, 2026) to three 60-minute televised debates in Portland, Eugene, and Medford 'starting in September' — none before September.
Oregon Gov. Kotek declined (June 18, 2026) a summer debate proposed by an Oregon newspaper group, citing a busy summer calendar.
Pennsylvania: Shapiro and Garrity both said (late June 2026) they are willing to debate at least once, but NO debate is scheduled (no date/host/moderator). Garrity called for seven debates.
No general-election gubernatorial debate is confirmed before September 2026 in PA, OR, AZ, or WI.
PA, OR, AZ, and WI all hold their general elections Nov. 3, 2026; PA and OR primaries were May 19, 2026 (nominees decided).
